generation_notes: Generated from the official UCKK course catalogue and canonical pathway documents.
This file is the relationship layer: it links programs to course ids defined in presets/courses.json.
Shared tronc commun progression is represented through prerequisite_pathway_refs instead of duplicating TC course refs into every program.
Repeated course titles with distinct course codes are flagged with variant_group and recognition_mode=specialized_variant where applicable.
competency_refs and badge_refs are intentionally empty until presets/competencies.json and presets/badges.json are generated.
